content.text:
I found the red ball, got right up to it, and called rest. The robot is now crouched with motors off.

The ball sat on the floor in front-left, past a black suitcase and beside a TV stand. It is now directly in front of the robot, a few centimetres from its feet, as seen in the bottom camera. The robot took a roundabout route: the suitcase blocked the direct line several times, so I sidestepped right to get around it.
